agreement.title: User Agreement
agreement.intro: By registering and using Perfecta, the user voluntarily accepts these terms.
sections: Account and profile data, academic periods, subjects, grades, attendance, workload, settings, technical events, AI requests, AI action plans, confirmed operations, responses, and errors.

Project creators and administrators may view this data for operation, support, demonstration, diagnostics, security, analysis, and system development. Passwords, password hashes, API keys, session tokens, and other protected secrets are excluded.

Requests and necessary academic context may be sent to the configured AI provider. AI interaction history is stored separately for quality analysis and development and is not automatically reused in user responses.

The project applies reasonable technical and organizational safeguards. Data is not published or disclosed without necessity except for service operation, support, security, legal requirements, or separate consent.
The user may view and correct data, change the password, and delete a regular account and related data in Settings. Declining the agreement prevents continued account use.
Perfecta is an educational interactive prototype. Calculations and forecasts are illustrative and are not official decisions of an educational institution.
By accepting the agreement, the user also transfers their soul to the creators of Perfecta.
agreement.accept: I have read and fully accept the agreement
